generation_contract.positive_template: Perform exactly one localized anatomical correction on the supplied image of one {size} {life_stage} {breed} {species} with a {body_build} anatomically normal body, a coherent {coat_color} {coat_length} coat with a {coat_pattern} pattern, and {ear_shape} ears: replace only the substantial free tail with one {tail_shape} tail.
generation_contract.pose_guard_prompt: The supplied v4 image is the authoritative pixel-level identity, appearance, anatomy, pose, camera, lighting, framing, and background reference. It is not a clay guide and must not be globally redrawn, restyled, or reposed. Preserve the same individual dog's head, ears, single visible eye, muzzle, expression, red-and-white coat colours and markings, fur detail, neck, chest, long low torso, short-legged proportions, four complete legs, four distinct planted paws, ground line, shadow, exact lateral camera, scale, and canvas placement as closely as diffusion permits. Keep all four existing limb and paw silhouettes anatomically connected and individually visible; do not move, merge, hide, add, or remove any limb or paw. The only authorized edit is the tail region at the rear rump. Erase the substantial red-and-white free tail shaft and its white tip that project down and backward from the rump. Fill the vacated tail area with the same plain grey background texture and lighting as its immediate surroundings. Retain exactly one tiny attached red-fur tail-root stump at the anatomical tail base. The stump may be a small rounded or triangular nub immediately behind the rump, but it must terminate before any visible free shaft begins. It must have no white tip, no curl, no plume, no downward or rearward continuation, and no tail-shaped shadow. Keep a clear plain-background gap between the entire stump and both hind-leg silhouettes and every paw. Do not modify any non-tail anatomy, coat marking, pose, camera, ground, shadow outside the erased-tail region, or background outside the erased-tail region.
